title: FIS AML agent built with Anthropic reaches US banks
key_facts: FIS announced commercial availability of the FIS AML Investigations Agent, first announced jointly with Anthropic in May 2026; from October 2026 it is available to any US-based bank, including non-FIS clients.
Amalgamated Bank, the design partner, is deploying it; it is the first product in FIS's planned roadmap of AI agents for banking.

Citing LexisNexis data from 2023, FIS says US financial institutions spend about USD 35 billion to 40 billion a year on anti-money-laundering (AML) operations; Datos Insights (2023) puts false-positive rates at 90% to 95%.

Amalgamated projects the agent will cut Level 1 alert review time by more than 90%, Level 2 case investigation time by about 98% and suspicious activity report narrative preparation time by more than 80%; these are projections, not measured results from live deployment.
The agent maps each alert against the customer's type, history and expected behaviour before assembling evidence and explains its rationale to the analyst.
All outputs are recommendations and no case can be closed without explicit analyst confirmation; recommendations, reasoning and the analyst's decision are logged in an audit trail.
FIS owns the agent, which runs in FIS's private cloud and uses Anthropic's Claude models; an Anthropic team worked embedded within FIS's product and compliance teams.
It integrates natively with FIS Horizon and FIS Systematics core banking platforms; FIS IBS is next.
